_comment: The strict profile, asked for by `--profile strict`. Read on top of playbook.default.json and
playbook.local.json, and it wins over both.
Zero repair: a refused frame is blocked as the answer wrote it and phase 3 stops there. It is never asked again,
never handed to the second look and never accepted with a warning, so the cause is fixed in the instruction, the
check or the settings rather than paid for again by another call. A refused frame tool blocks the chapter the same
way. Every watched run uses it (the monitoring default); an unwatched run reads the default settings' repair values.
The default settings hold the tolerated values instead: frames go back in a repair call, a frame still not finished is
sent by itself, and a refused frame tool only costs that tool's turn.

framesProcessing._comment: one frame refused ends phase 3: no repair call, no single-frame attempt

budgets._comment: a refused frame tool blocks the chapter and stops the run, so the tool or its instruction is fixed first
